# Wine Tours Valparaíso

> Guided wine tours to Chile's Casablanca Valley, with hotel pickup from Valparaíso, Viña del Mar and Santiago, and collection from the Valparaíso and San Antonio cruise ports.

Wine Tours Valparaíso is a small tour operator based in Valparaíso, Chile, running guided tours to the Casablanca Valley — a cool-climate wine region between Santiago and the Pacific coast, known for Sauvignon Blanc, Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Syrah. Tours visit the Bodegas RE and Casas del Bosque wineries and include transport with a driver and guide, winery entrance fees, and tours and tastings at both estates. The company also runs city tours of Valparaíso and Viña del Mar.

Tours are conducted in English and Spanish. Private tours and custom itineraries are available, and larger groups can be accommodated with advance booking.

## Tours

- [Classic Wine Tour](https://winetoursvalparaiso.com/tours/classic-wine-tour/): Half Day Experience. Bodegas RE vineyard tour and premium tasting, then Casas del Bosque vineyard tour and tasting of their Sauvignon Blanc, Pinot Noir, Syrah, and Carmenère Gran Reserva. From CLP 75,000 per person.
- [Wine & Dine Tour](https://winetoursvalparaiso.com/tours/wine-dine-tour/): Full Day Experience. Bodegas RE vineyard tour and premium tasting, Casas del Bosque vineyard tour and tasting of their Sauvignon Blanc, Pinot Noir, Syrah, and Carmenère Gran Reserva, then Lunch at Casas del Bosque vineyard restaurant. From CLP 135,000 per person; lunch is not included in the price.
- [Wine Tours from Santiago](https://winetoursvalparaiso.com/tours/wine-tours-from-santiago/): Full Day Experience. Arrival in Casablanca Valley, Bodegas RE vineyard tour and premium tasting, Casas del Bosque vineyard tour and tasting of their Sauvignon Blanc, Pinot Noir, Syrah, and Carmenère Gran Reserva, Lunch at Casas del Bosque vineyard restaurant, Scenic drive to Valparaíso, Walking tour of Valparaíso's colorful hills, including Cerro Alegre and Cerro Concepción by funicular, and La Sebastiana (Pablo Neruda's house), then Drop off in Valparaíso or return to Santiago. From CLP 115,000 per person; lunch is not included in the price.
- [Valparaíso & Viña del Mar](https://winetoursvalparaiso.com/tours/valparaiso-vina-del-mar/): City Tour. Viña del Mar city tour, including the Fonck archaeological museum, Valparaíso city tour through Cerro Alegre and Cerro Concepción by funicular, past La Sebastiana, Pablo Neruda's house, then Optional boat trip in the bay of Valparaíso. From CLP 45,000 per person; boat trip is optional and not included in the price.

Prices are per person in Chilean pesos and vary with group size and pickup or drop-off point.

## Guides and reference

- [Casablanca Valley Wineries Guide](https://winetoursvalparaiso.com/wineries/): A guide to twelve wineries in the Casablanca Valley — Casas del Bosque, Emiliana Organic Vineyards, Bodegas RE, William Cole Vineyards, Matetic Vineyards, Viña Indómita, Kingston Vineyards, Villard Fine Wines, Loma Larga Vineyards, Catrala, Morandé, Attilio & Mochi — covering what each is known for and how to reach the valley from Valparaíso or Santiago.
- [Places to Stay in Valparaíso](https://winetoursvalparaiso.com/where-to-stay/valparaiso/): Where to stay in Valparaíso by neighborhood and budget — boutique hotels and hostels in Cerro Alegre and Cerro Concepción, plus when Viña del Mar makes more sense.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://winetoursvalparaiso.com/faq/): Twenty-two questions covering tours & itineraries, prices & booking, getting there & pickup, practical, and about us.

## Practical details

- Departure points: hotels in Valparaíso, Viña del Mar and Santiago.
- Cruise passengers: pickup and drop-off at the Valparaíso cruise terminal and the port of San Antonio. Valparaíso pricing is shown in the site's price calculator; San Antonio is quoted on request.
- Wineries visited on tours: Bodegas RE and Casas del Bosque, both in the Casablanca Valley.
- Booking: by enquiry through the website contact form, email or WhatsApp — there is no instant online checkout. At least 24 hours' notice is required.
- Payment: major credit cards, PayPal, and cash in Chilean pesos.
- Cancellation: full refund with 48 hours' notice; partial refund after that.
- Transport with a driver and guide is included in all tours.
- Children are welcome; tastings are for adults only.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices listed here are starting prices and may change. The individual tour pages linked above are the current source.
- The Casablanca Valley Wineries Guide describes wineries across the valley generally. Only Bodegas RE and Casas del Bosque are visited on the standard tours listed above.
- This business operates on winetoursvalparaiso.com. The similarly named winetoursvalparaiso.cl and valparaisowinetours.com are unrelated businesses.
